command: BEGIN; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='20s'; CREATE SCHEMA qa443_local; SET LOCAL search_path=qa443_local,public; CREATE TABLE items_half(id integer PRIMARY KEY,embedding halfvec(3) NOT NULL); INSERT INTO items_half VALUES (1,'[1,2,3]'),(2,'[2,2,3]'),(3,'[1,4,3]'),(4,'[1,2,7]'),(5,'[9,2,3]'); CREATE INDEX items_half_hnsw ON items_half USING hnsw(embedding halfvec_l2_ops); SET LOCAL enable_seqscan=off; SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(id,distance) ORDER BY distance))::text FROM (SELECT id,embedding <-> '[1,2,3]'::halfvec(3) AS distance FROM items_half ORDER BY embedding <-> '[1,2,3]'::halfvec(3) LIMIT 3) q; EXPLAIN(ANALYZE TRUE,FORMAT JSON,COSTS OFF,TIMING OFF,SUMMARY OFF) SELECT id,embedding <-> '[1,2,3]'::halfvec(3) AS distance FROM items_half ORDER BY embedding <-> '[1,2,3]'::halfvec(3) LIMIT 3; ROLLBACK;
